title: Serialize agency agreement draft edits and evidence lifecycle transitions
description: Close agency fee agreement frozen-evidence race. AgencyServiceFeeAgreementService.UpdateAsync loads/checks Draft then edits, while RecordAsync loads/checks and freezes status/audit without common transaction/row lock; VoidAsync similarly reads and writes unguarded. A draft edit can persist after another request records or voids evidence, or two registrations overwrite recorded audit. Add minimal shared AgencyFeeEvidenceConcurrencyRules through existing service/controller flow; use same agreement lock for update/record/void and re-read authoritative state/terms/authority under lock. Preserve create uniqueness and existing fee terms/currency boundaries. No statement generation, fee inference or new business authority. Preserve existing current identity/menu/customer scope and explicit source ownership; recheck in locked authoritative state without new grants. Reuse relational transaction/row-lock patterns from existing business services, ensure deterministic documented lock order and safe nested transaction handling. No schema/migration, microservice, new database, implicit fee calculation or accounting/receipt posting. Clear failed tracked changes on rejection as existing business patterns require; no partial state/rows/audit/snapshots. Historical reads and void evidence retained, no deletion/backfill of snapshots. Adapt necessary original fixtures genuinely with original assertions intact. All logs/TRX under .ai/logs/<task>, original failures retained. Mandatory true two-independent-connection SQL race tests using barriers/controlled ordering, never timing sleeps alone; fresh dedicated GUID NEWERP_AUTOTEST only, no drop/reset/reuse/production. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Agreement update/record/void use same existing-entity lock and transaction, re-reading current status and live authority/customer scope before mutations. Recorded/voided evidence cannot receive a stale draft edit; registration exactly once preserves winner audit, terms and immutable customer snapshots.

Failure/revoked access leaves all fields/status/audit unchanged, original fee-method/currency/storage/date validations remain. Preserve supported historical read/void semantics and controlled stale/conflict errors, no fallback unprotected relational writes or provider/test permission exemptions.

Meaningful unit/service/controller and genuine isolated two-connection SQL races cover update versus record/void, record versus record/void, duplicate identity create if affected, revoked authority and valid lifecycle. Assert stored status/terms/audit equal one serialized ordering and no partial writes. Run original agreement SQL/terms/scope/void regressions and safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: AgencyServiceFeeAgreementService UpdateAsync:89-139 and RecordAsync:234-265 / VoidAsync:270 use Load/state checks followed by writes without BeginTransaction/Lock; controller has no transaction/lock wrapper. ERP-069/439 add explicit evidence/authority and516 adds stored terms, not common mutation lock. Full history/docs search for agency/agreement concurrency found receipt/allocation tasks349/350/378 only, no agreement serialization.
